name: App Template
description: TEMPLATE — the fastest way to start a new aw-workspace app. Install it and you have a working app on day one: a `template` CLI that prints a configurable greeting, its own window in the Apps grid, and an HTTP + WebSocket backend — with tests and marketplace release already wired. The scaffold names its app, CLI, route and Python package after itself, so renaming every `template` occurrence to your app's name is the whole rename; see README.md.

skills.description: How to author a decoupled aw-workspace app from this template — manifest, tiers, capabilities, contributes, backend routes (HTTP+WS), frontend code, standalone mode, window widgets, install + marketplace release.

greeting.description: Word the installed `template` command prints before the target name, e.g. "Hello, world!".
